# Market Monitor Panels
Vue 2 dashboard components under zhi2-web-admin/src/views/property/marketMonitor/components/, ported from a minified React bundle on 2026-11-04.

## Components
- TradePanel.vue: ported from Ree; two-column panel (商品住房 blue / 存量住房 emerald), each column has 全市合计 + 市区 blocks with 4 metrics (成交套数/面积/金额/单价), a donut pie via ChartBox plus a DistrictPie beside it; year/month selects and a toggle. Uses data Iee (commercial) / Lee (resale).
- AgencyPanel.vue: ported from ze; purple 中介机构 card with 3 stats (企业数 家 / 人员数 万人 / 网签数 笔) plus MoM badges; icons users, building-2, user-check, file-pen-line.
- AreaStructurePanel.vue: ported from Re; inline Le bracket echarts config; three-档 stacked bar + legend + 3 detail rows (商品房/存量房 cards); props data/theme.
- DistrictPie.vue: sibling component written by dev-a; props dataPoints array of {district, units}; used in TradePanel via <district-pie :data-points="..." />.

## Relations
- Part of the zhi2-web-admin portal project (Vue2 + Element UI + echarts + Vite).
- Foundation reused: assets/dashboard.css (scoped tailwind under .mm-dashboard), components/LucideIcon.vue, components/ChartBox.vue (props option, height), assets/data.js exporting Iee, Lee, Z9, Q9, x, S, C, w, b, themes, districtInfo.
